source.title: Ask HN: Dark mode for HN please? (2026)
source.text: The 2020 thread does a lot: It shows 100 solutions in light of Parkinson’s Law of Triviality. Intense opinions and discussion. It teaches about alligator energy and how they can live without food for up to two years.
